Fixed trace comparison preserves parser behavior, not generated meaning. Fixture strings contain no delimiter ambiguity; this is not proof of general trace encoding.

Builtin provider/model/quirk/URI/env keys, option enums, UA/cache/POST route, parameter absence, normalized schema, supplied peer body/model and usage are real machine/data contracts. Description and ok comparisons preserve given input only.

Original generated error/detail RegExp/includes/exact sentences and requestPayloadPath/debugCaptureError rendered-marker checks removed. Actual Error rejection/counts/structured identities remain automatic; all12 complete natural diagnostics are judged above.

Stream hook gets exactly1 invalid object and0 normal/streamError callbacks; no-hook gets1 streamError plus throw. Batch invalid existence and0 valid func_calls are narrower than all output uniqueness. kind=message/invalid_func_call and message.type remain genuine discriminants.

Actual contained path, full JSON readback, regular-file capture failure, cause identity, status/code and public classifier prove preserved original rejection and request evidence. Generated prose is judged separately.

UA negative prefix follows from exact UA. Thinking reference identity is incidental and replaced by full given fields/source immutability. Partial source schema checks subsumed by full expected normalized schema and entire source comparison.

assertionReview.helper: compatible-peer uses real localhost HTTP, increments received requestCount before parsing, treats response as unknown wire JSON, captures parsed request, records server/request/parse errors and checks them after run, restores independent fake-key env and closes server in finally. No semantic detector introduced; invalid SDK JSON is not falsely asserted to satisfy ChatCompletion.
assertionReview.entryAndLifecycle: Both candidates retain a60s watchdog equal to existing runner limit, cleared after all work/evidence writes or rejection; it prevents unfinished async work with no handles from exiting0, not synchronization/retry/time-limit expansion. compatible and semantic lanes register only two cases; helper is not discovered as a passing case. Direct aliases now use isolated rtws. Writer emits pending and runner separates successful generation from semanticAcceptance=pending.
assertionReview.ledgerAndDocs: Both entries preserve8/18 original values with explicit compatible lane. AGENTS/README/strategy distinguish local SDK from stream parser, diagnostic injection from actual provider failure, and104 inherited full-test type errors remain failure. No prior ledger/verdict auto-accepts fresh text.

limitations: No live Kimi/Volc/MiniMax service, authentication or real-vendor advertised capability verification. Builtin values are checked-in configuration contracts.
Streaming uses the real parser with supplied AsyncIterable chunks, not SDK streaming or a network stream. Batch/Kimi local HTTP scenarios do traverse the actual SDK.
No tool execution, driver recovery, scheduling, dialog persistence repair, restart, browser or WebSocket claim. Rejected-error enrichment receives an injected upstream Error.
Batch invalid presence is not total output uniqueness. Supplied trace fixtures do not establish general delimiter-safe logging.
Only these2 candidates/26 original values and12 final semantic cases are reviewed. Other109 unaudited candidates remain outside this acceptance; full inherited test types remain failed.
All observed /tmp paths are run identities only. Complete material/context and retained capture content are embedded; temporary directory survival is not a durable acceptance dependency.
Source and output SHA256 identify reviewed bytes only; no hash judges meaning or automatically accepts later output. SUT fingerprints do not imply every source function was reviewed.

baselineAndDesignHistory.baselineMeaning: Two original processes exited0, not original-design acceptance. Invalid reasoning details/missing name/ENOTDIR ERROR logs are expected negative component tests, not hidden live-model failures. No product defect is asserted from those intentional logs.
